dataset_metadata.description: Applicant profile and financial attributes used for personal-loan underwriting and fair-lending analysis.

dataset_level_description.business_purpose: Records the applicant profile and financial state available at the time of credit application.
dataset_level_description.business_question_supported: What are the applicant's relevant financial, employment, and geographic attributes at submission, and do they satisfy eligibility requirements?
dataset_level_description.grain: One record per applicant application event identified by applicant_id.
dataset_level_description.storage_and_ingestion: Validated applicant records loaded into the analytics platform through incremental batch ingestion.
dataset_level_description.ai_consumption: Provides underwriting features, current case context, and fair-lending monitoring inputs.
dataset_level_description.ai_assumption: Applicant-declared income and employment information is verified, and fields represent the information available at application time.

column_level_contract.business_meaning: Unique applicant identifier used to connect the applicant profile to credit checks and loan decisions.
Calendar date on which the credit application was submitted and the point-in-time anchor for applicant attributes.
Self-reported or verified gross annual income used in repayment-capacity review.
Length of employment at application time, used as a stability factor in underwriting.
Credit score used for applicant risk assessment at or near application time.
Risk category derived from the credit score or approved policy tiers and used to support consistent underwriting decisions.
Geographic grouping used for availability, operational reporting, and fairness monitoring; it must not be treated as an unsupported risk proxy.
Date used to calculate applicant age as of application_date for eligibility and compliance monitoring.
Applicant occupational status at application time, used to assess stable repayment capacity.
Applicant housing context at application time for underwriting context and monitoring.
Applicant state used for jurisdiction, product availability, and geographic monitoring.

record_level_rules: applicant_id must be unique and must resolve across related credit_pull_events and loan_applications records when those records exist.
income, employment_duration, and credit_score must satisfy their non-negative or bounded validation rules.
credit_risk_tier must align with the applicable approved credit-score policy.
Applicants under 18 years old as of application_date must have a Denied loan application status.
An applicant with a Poor credit_risk_tier must be escalated to an Under Review loan application status.
region, birth_date, and housing_status are monitoring or contextual fields and must not be used as unsupported proxies for credit risk.
